summary: Frontend-only retest for iteration_16 fix passed on public URL. Offline marker/legend class alignment works and all requested admin map regressions are green.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for this retest scope.
Optional maintainability: split AdminDashboard.jsx into smaller modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is still very large (>700 lines), increasing change-risk for future map/admin edits.
Admin Settings tab remains MOCKED/demo in this build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md on https://delivery-dispatch-17.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed in map tab: driver markers=5 (active=4, busy=0, offline=1), restaurant markers=5, polygons/overlay paths=0, offline marker and legend use slate linear-gradient via delivery-map-marker-driver-offline and delivery-map-legend-driver-offline classes. New Order/New Driver/New Restaurant dialogs open correctly. 'Tur Client' remains absent. No runtime JS error reproduced in admin map flow; console only shows expected pre-auth 401 checks before login.
rca of the issue: Previous failure root cause (iteration_16) was naming mismatch between generated marker class (offline) and CSS token (idle). After standardizing to offline in marker/legend CSS selectors, computed style now resolves to slate gradient and regression is cleared.
